title: PBS Cluster Overview
description: PBS cluster capacity, GPU use, projects, users, queues and idle GPU jobs (pbs-exporter v2).

panels.title: GPU allocation
panels.description: Share of the cluster's GPUs that PBS has assigned to running jobs.

panels.title: GPUs allocated / total
panels.description: GPUs assigned to running jobs, out of all GPUs on nodes PBS manages.

panels.title: Actual GPU use
panels.description: Average GPU utilization measured by DCGM across all GPUs of the cluster, right now. Compare with GPU allocation: a big gap means GPUs are reserved but not working.

targets.expr: avg(max by (node, gpu) (label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL, "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+)(?::.*)?")) and on (node) pbs_node_state{job=~"$job"})

panels.title: GPUs held but idle
panels.description: GPUs held by running jobs that have no GPU process or under 1% GPU use for 30 minutes. Only nodes that report gpu_process_count are checked.

panels.title: Waiting jobs
panels.description: Jobs waiting to start: Queued (Q) are waiting for resources, Held (H) are on hold.

panels.title: GPU demand waiting
panels.description: GPUs requested by queued (Q) jobs: the backlog the cluster cannot serve right now.

panels.title: Longest queue wait
panels.description: How long the oldest queued (Q) job has been waiting.

targets.expr: max(pbs_job_queued_seconds{job=~"$job"} and on (job_id) pbs_job_queued_info{job=~"$job", state="Q"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Active projects
panels.description: Projects with at least one running job.

panels.title: Exporter health
panels.description: OK when every PBS command the exporter runs succeeded last time. FAILING means some numbers on this dashboard are stale; see Exporter health below.

panels.title: GPU capacity, allocation and idle
panels.description: Allocated vs. total GPUs, how many allocated GPUs sit idle, and the waiting demand.

panels.title: GPU use vs. allocation (%)
panels.description: Allocated % is what PBS hands out; actual use % is what the GPUs really do (DCGM).

targets.expr: avg(max by (node, gpu) (label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL, "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+)(?::.*)?")) and on (node) pbs_node_state{job=~"$job"})

panels.title: Projects
panels.description: Per project: GPUs and jobs running now, and what is waiting.

panels.title: Top projects by GPUs in use

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (user) (pbs_job_gpus{job=~"$job"} * on (job_id, node) group_left (user) pbs_job_info{job=~"$job"}))

panels.title: Queues
panels.description: Every queue PBS reports, discovered automatically.

panels.title: Idle right now
panels.description: Running jobs that hold GPUs with no GPU process, or under 1% GPU use over 30 minutes.

panels.title: Idle 30+ minutes (alert firing)
panels.description: Jobs that have stayed idle long enough to fire the PBSJobGPUIdle alert.

targets.expr: topk(25, pbs_job_queued_seconds{job=~"$job"} * on (job_id) group_left (user, project, queue, job_name, state) pbs_job_queued_info{job=~"$job"})
avg by (node) (max by (node, gpu) (label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL, "node", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+)(?::.*)?")) and on (node) pbs_node_state{job=~"$job"})

panels.title: PBS commands
panels.description: Each PBS command the exporter runs every cycle. Data age above a few minutes means stale numbers.
